source.description: Expression for single-value binding, or dataSource ID for collection binding

Position.description: Positioning for children of absolute layout containers

repeat.description: Accepted so validation can say why it never renders: put the repeat on a node in content (REPEAT_INVALID_HOST).

WireframeStyleOverride.description: Partial wireframe style for per-node and per-overlay overrides. No fields required — inherits from page.

platform.description: Chrome skin. Defaults to ios for mobile and tablet, web otherwise. Changes chrome only, never which elements exist.

separatorPolicy.description: Shorthand separator policy. auto/divide render parent dividers only when gap is 0; gutters/no dividers win when gap is greater than 0.

separators.description: Draw dividers between sibling children. Only effective when gap is 0.

mode.description: Rendering mode. line = blueprint/schematic. card = greyscale product mock.

density.description: Layout density. comfortable = default spacing. compact = reduced spacing.

explain.description: Emit data-wf-why on every node, explaining its frame decision.

component.description: Primitive component name or reusable component ID

role.description: Semantic role. A known role drives built-in proportions and the frame decision.

surface.description: Explicitly marks a node as a framed surface or forces it to remain content-only.

elevation.description: Card-mode elevation token. Ignored in line mode.

slots.description: Named slot fills, only on a use: node. Each key is a slot the component declares; the value is the nodes that fill it. [] leaves a slot empty on purpose. Instance children fill the "default" slot.

repeat.description: Rows of one cell, keyed by item id, after the node's children.

sticky.description: Stays at an edge of its containing scroll area. Put the bar before the content it must stay above.

scroll.description: Opt into native overflow scrolling without resizing. Bound the node with size.height/maxHeight or width/maxWidth; sticky children use this scroll boundary.

when.description: Draw this node only when the value has content. In a component, write a prop token ("{{props.tagline}}"): a caller who leaves the prop blank, null, false or an empty list gets no node. Evaluated after props, slots and repeat rows resolve.

NodeOrSlot.description: A node, or a slot placeholder: any object with a slot key is read as a placeholder.

SlotPlaceholder.description: Marks where an instance's content goes inside a reusable component. Valid only inside a component definition, never as its root (SLOT_OUTSIDE_COMPONENT).

slot.description: Slot name. Instance children fill "default"; slots.<name> fills the others.

children.description: Fallback content, used when the instance gives no fill for this slot.

repeat.description: Accepted so validation can say why it never renders: a placeholder is replaced (REPEAT_INVALID_HOST).

Repeat.description: One cell rendered once per item, after the node's own children, as if each row were written by hand. A row's id is <node id>__<item id>. Only a concrete element node that lays out its children hosts rows; anywhere else it is REPEAT_INVALID_HOST.

cell.description: An element name or alias, which wins, else a component reference written as for use: (a local id, alias.id or std.<name>).

items.description: One row per item: the cell's props plus the item's id.

id.description: The item's stable key, unique in this repeat. The row renders as <node id>__<id>.

sticky.description: Makes this top-level region sticky during scroll. top = sticks to top of viewport. bottom = sticks to bottom.

role.description: Semantic role. A known role drives built-in proportions and the frame decision.

surface.description: Force this region to draw a frame, or force it not to.

inset.description: Outer page padding in CSS pixels, independent of template/body padding. Omitted preserves mode/platform defaults.

fields.description: Expected field names for items (informational, used for validation hints)

items.description: Array of plain key-value objects, each containing the primaryKey field

SizingTokens.description: Project-wide overrides for built-in proportions, token name to pixels.

PrimitiveProps_section.description: Generic container. The frame rules decide whether it gets a box.

PrimitiveProps_card.description: Always a framed card, at any nesting depth.

PrimitiveProps_grid.description: Grid layout group. Never framed; its children become framed tiles. Without columns the tiles fill the row and wrap.

PrimitiveProps_split.description: Side-by-side resizable panes. The panes are framed, the split is not.

PrimitiveProps_form.description: Groups fields and a submit action. Never framed; wrap in a card for a box.

label.description: Accepted alias for text; text wins when both are set.

PrimitiveProps_paragraph.description: Body copy. Without text it renders skeleton lines.

label.description: Accepted alias for text; text wins when both are set.
Accepted alias for text; text wins when both are set.

PrimitiveProps_code.description: Monospaced code block. Set inline: true for an inline run.

PrimitiveProps_badge.description: Badge, pill, chip, tag or status dot. variant is the shape, tone the status.

PrimitiveProps_avatar.description: User avatar from initials or an image; group renders a stack with +n.

PrimitiveProps_icon.description: Font Awesome icon; falls back to a lettered glyph box without the font.

PrimitiveProps_image.description: Image or media placeholder. kind picks the placeholder glyph.

PrimitiveProps_rating.description: Star rating with optional review count.

PrimitiveProps_stat.description: KPI tile: label, value, optional delta/trend/sparkline.

PrimitiveProps_divider.description: Horizontal or vertical rule, optionally labelled.

PrimitiveProps_empty_state.description: Centred empty, error, 404 or offline state with an optional action.

PrimitiveProps_button.description: Button in five variants, three sizes; iconOnly and fab for icon buttons; pressed makes it a toggle.

PrimitiveProps_toolbar.description: Row or column of tool buttons with pressed and checked toggles, separators and groups. Never a box: it draws its own button-group outline.

PrimitiveProps_segmented.description: Segmented control; option values (else labels) select, and a label makes it a field.

PrimitiveProps_input.description: Single-line field. inputType covers search, date, range, otp, colour and more; min, max and step bound number, range and stepper.

PrimitiveProps_select.description: Dropdown field; searchable turns it into a combobox; value (a list with multiple) is the initial selection.

PrimitiveProps_checkbox.description: Single checkbox with optional description; indeterminate draws the mixed state.

PrimitiveProps_choice_group.description: A labelled set of checkboxes or radios in one node; a checkbox group takes a list value.

PrimitiveProps_upload.description: File dropzone, or a plain upload button with variant: button. label is the action copy; fieldLabel goes above.

PrimitiveProps_picker.description: Native wheel picker. On web this is a select; on iOS and Android it is the spinner.

PrimitiveProps_editor.description: Rich-text editor placeholder with an optional toolbar strip.

PrimitiveProps_tab_bar.description: Local tabs select by unique label; routed tabs navigate. Pass tabs[] or children.

PrimitiveProps_bottom_tab_bar.description: Mobile bottom tab bar, icon above label.

PrimitiveProps_breadcrumb.description: Breadcrumb trail; the last crumb is current unless an item says otherwise.

PrimitiveProps_pagination.description: Page controls; variant dots doubles as carousel/onboarding dots.

PrimitiveProps_nav.description: Side navigation; rail stacks icons above labels; collapsed hides labels; top is a horizontal site menu whose open item draws its panel. Put a sidebar or rail in a template region with role: sidebar beside main.

PrimitiveProps_menu.description: Menu item list. On the page it draws as a dropdown panel; in a dropdown, card or modal the container owns the frame.

PrimitiveProps_menubar.description: Desktop application menu row. A title with items is a menu; open draws its panel. A title without items is a plain link: give it a route, never a one-item menu repeating its name. Mark the page with current, not open. At the top level it draws as a menu strip; in a framed bar the bar owns it.

PrimitiveProps_command.description: Command palette: search row, grouped results with icons, descriptions and key-chip shortcuts. Framed on its own; inside a card or modal the container owns the frame.

PrimitiveProps_app_bar.description: Mobile top chrome: a leading glyph or control, title, trailing actions.

PrimitiveProps_action_sheet.description: Native action list for a bottom sheet: choices plus a cancel row.

PrimitiveProps_page_header.description: Page title block: breadcrumb, title, subtitle, actions and tabs.

PrimitiveProps_table.description: Data table with typed columns, routed link cells, selection, sorting and loading/empty states.

PrimitiveProps_list.description: List rows. kind covers plain, avatar, action, file, chat and timeline shapes.

PrimitiveProps_chart.description: Greeked chart placeholder in ten shapes. Deterministic, never random. gantt draws data [{ label, start, end, tone }] as bars on one axis labelled by ticks.

label.description: Accepted alias for title; title wins when both are set.

PrimitiveProps_calendar.description: Month, week, day or compact picker grid.

PrimitiveProps_kanban.description: Board of columns; each column is a framed surface, the board is not.

PrimitiveProps_tree.description: Nested tree or file browser. Items stay open unless they set expanded: false.

PrimitiveProps_accordion.description: Collapsible rows; set expanded on the item that starts open.

PrimitiveProps_alert.description: Banner or inline alert. Variants differ by glyph, stripe hue and edge weight.
